parsed.name: 西门子 LOGO! 可编程逻辑控制器
parsed.description: 西门子 LOGO! 是一类紧凑型可编程逻辑控制器/智能继电器，常用于小型自动化控制系统。实验室中可用于读取开关量状态、保存简单变量和模拟量数值，并控制继电器、指示灯、泵阀等基础设备。
parsed.description_en: The Siemens LOGO! is a compact programmable logic controller / smart relay commonly used in small automation systems. In laboratories, it can be used to read digital states, store simple variables and analog values, and control basic equipment such as relays, indicator lamps, pumps, and valves.
